body: @zeljkot could you prepare a quick reproducer for that one?

It looks like there are 2 different issues and I'm pretty sure it's going to be a bit hard to reproduce.

Thanks!

I managed to reproduce first error, here is the reproducer. Note that it might be necessary to adjust the loop in the ClassicEntityRepositoryRest class.

[blocking-operation.zip](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/4320434/blocking-operation.zip)

This is because the vert.x hot deployment handler can resume on a different IO thread. Undertow only checks that the current thread is not the connections IO thread, so it does not realise it needs to dispatch to a blocking executor.

This could also happen with OIDC I think.
Fix is in the linked PR

I don't think there is much we can do about the transaction timeout exception. When you get a transaction being timed out from another thread it is hard to handle it well.

@Sanne is there a recommended way to deal with TX timeout with the EM?

> @Sanne is there a recommended way to deal with TX timeout with the EM?

Not really; AFAIK this is a problem on WildFly as well, since a long time. I remember making a relatively simple proposal on the Narayana forums about how to fix it but they didn't like it.  I'm a bit overwhelmed at the moment but would love to revive that conversation - maybe with you as we seem more open to make changes?

You could maybe add some code to our EM wrapper to handle it, detect if a thread is invoking an operation on timeout and then interrupt the thread, and have the main application thread actually do the close.
